summary: Iteration 5 frontend-only verification for ఉష కిరాణా Telugu POS. Verified /month mobile overflow bug fix, all 9 pages compile/load with no webpack overlay and no page errors, and e2e smoke (login → billing b2+Enter → cash bill save with window.print override → daily report reflects new bill → items page loads → history reprint → khata statement). All checks pass. Launch-ready from frontend side.

test_results.all_pages_compile_and_load: PASS — /, /items, /import, /khata, /history, /report, /week, /month, /settings all loaded with sw=cw=390 on mobile, no webpack error overlay, no pageerror console events.
test_results.regression_month_desktop: PASS — item×day matrix visible with day totals row and search input (data-testid='month-item-search').
test_results.regression_week_desktop: PASS — weekly matrix, summary cards, prev/next navigation intact.
test_results.e2e_smoke: PASS — Login OK. Billing: b2+Enter added కందిపప్పు, grand-total=₹168.00. checkout-btn (సేవ్) saved bill, window.print called once (override captured). Daily report shows bill count 21 and gross ₹8,362 including new bill. Items page loads with inline code/price/stock inputs, no crash overlay. Khata page lists customers with total-due testid. History reprint button triggered window.print successfully.

critical_code_review_comments: Login page uses data-testid='login-email-input'/'login-password-input'/'login-submit-btn'. Prior review request example used 'login-email'/'login-password'/'login-submit' which does not match — worth aligning naming convention across app if new tests are authored.
seed_data_creation: One cash bill for item b2 (కందిపప్పు) ₹168 created during smoke test. Kirana test data (bills, customers, items) preserved.
